The theorem computes the full norm-scale profile for the canonical type-B reflection groups in all dimensions, rigidly identifies worst rank-one pairs, and optimizes the same profile among every finite planar orthogonal group of bounded cardinality, including the sharp N^-2 convergence rate. This answers a natural quantitative orbit-approximation question rather than an arbitrary numerical slice; the golden-ratio high-dimensional limit exhibits distinct asymptotic behavior.
